Class Colours

java.lang.Object
com.atomictempest.holograms.api.Colours
public final class Colours extends Object
Colour codes in hologram text. Coloured holograms (TextImage) draw them; plain floating text cannot be coloured by the game, so there they are taken out (strip(String)). Since API_VERSION 3.
  • &c, &a, ... the 16 classic colours (&0-&9, &a-&f); &r back to white
  • &#FF8800 or <#FF8800>: any colour
  • <red>, <gold>, <aqua>, ...: the same 16 colours by name; </red> back to white
  • <gradient:#FF0000:#0000FF>text</gradient>: from one colour to the next, letter by letter (two or more colours)
  • <rainbow>text</rainbow>
